title: Elden Ring VR (ERVR)
author: IlyaMez
summary: Native VR for ELDEN RING: your head is the camera, the weapons are in your hands, and your swing is the attack.
highlights: Native VR mod, not a UEVR profile
From the maker of Spidy VR

title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 VR (UEVR)
author: letmein-vr
summary: UEVR mod for S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl. It needs the custom UEVR build from its releases page; inject at the main menu once shader compilation has finished.
highlights: Custom UEVR build included in the release

title: Twilight Princess VR (TPVR)
author: JoeyAW
summary: VR mod for Dusklight, the PC port of The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess, aiming to stay true to the original game while playing it in VR.
highlights: Not affiliated with the Dusklight team

title: REFramework
author: praydog
summary: Mod loader, scripting platform and VR support for RE Engine games: Resident Evil 2, 3, 4, 7, 8 and 9, Devil May Cry 5, Monster Hunter Rise and Wilds, Street Fighter 6 and more.
highlights: VR for every RE Engine game

title: NomaiVR (Outer Wilds VR)
author: Raicuparta
summary: Outer Wilds VR mod with 6DOF tracking and full motion control support.
